Question Choices: How many values are in the repeating cycle of powers of i?
Hints: List i i^2 i^3 and i^4.|The next power returns to i.
Solution: The cycle is i, -1, -i, 1. Multiplication by i returns to the first value, so there are 4 distinct values in the cycle.
